workflow: Engineers prepare source and fresh evidence.
Both specialists in every affected discipline review independently before seeing the partner’s findings.
Each pair discusses concrete differences; both explicitly confirm its joint recommendation and record any remaining objection.
For major creative decisions and milestones, all eighteen specialists review the cross-disciplinary proposal and register their own position.
Investigate objections, revise work or justify a scoped decision with evidence, and re-review the affected claims. Consensus is recorded only when all eighteen explicitly agree to that same scope.
Scores describe the reviewed work. A target score never changes a reviewer’s recorded judgment.
Present the resulting work, agreement, evidence and remaining limits to Nag. Publication follows actual authorization.
invariants: Geometry and numeric poses shared across themes
Actual project evidence and first-person authorship
No automatic requirement for extra detail, continuous wing flutter, sound or scenery
AI consensus is not human audience evidence

consensusProtocol.rule: An unresolved substantive objection means no full-team consensus. Silence, inactivity, pair-lead approval and majority votes do not count as unanimous agreement.
consensusProtocol.scope: Agreement states exactly what is accepted: plan, experiment or completed implementation. A plan agreement is not artwork approval or an automatic 9/10.
consensusProtocol.independence: Second specialists start with separate contexts and complementary lenses. These remain AI-agent perspectives, not independent human research.
consensusProtocol.execution: Run in available batches; runtime persistence is not guaranteed, so preserve roles, decisions and records.

qualityPolicy.priority: Quality first, explicitly requested by Nag.
qualityPolicy.configuration: Explicit model and reasoning arguments for every active panel reviewer. Preserve predecessor review history when creating fresh reviewer contexts.
qualityPolicy.capacity: 18 standing specialists, scheduled within available active-agent slots; not 18 simultaneous executions.
qualityPolicy.scoring: Do not trade honest judgments for unanimous 9s. Re-score improved evidence after implementation.
